summary: Full backend + frontend e2e testing of ARCHER GRID. 19/19 pytest cases pass; all UI flows (login -> detect -> dashboard -> devices -> analytics -> control -> security -> logout) work without runtime errors. 3D hologram renders correctly with three.js canvas.

issues: Recharts emits a transient 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warning on first render before the parent container resolves its size. Charts ultimately render correctly. Non-blocking, but adding minWidth/minHeight on ResponsiveContainer would silence the warning.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Wrap Recharts ResponsiveContainer with explicit minWidth=0/minHeight=200 on Analytics page to avoid console warning during initial layout.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/router/connect ignores body.password but mock-only intentional - documented as demo. OK.
/api/router/status mutates ROUTER_STATE.stats on every GET (tx/rx bytes incremented). Side-effect on a GET is non-idempotent but harmless for demo telemetry.
DEVICES is module-level mutable global, fine for single-process demo but not horizontally scalable. Acceptable for MVP.
WebSocket /api/ws/live decodes JWT but doesn't verify user still exists; acceptable for demo. Polling fallback works at 5s as documented.
Login response returns token both in body and httpOnly cookie (secure, samesite=none) - both auth modes verified working.
seed_data_creation: None - backend seeds admin user automatically; signal/object data is mathematically simulated (mocked) as documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_archer_grid.py cover all 4 modules (auth/router/signals/objects) with 19 cases including unauth(401), CRUD-with-GET-verify pattern, and device block/unblock state assertion. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend UI manually traversed: login form -> detect (cable scan ~9s) -> connect (demo mode) -> dashboard (6 stat tiles + holo-3d-panel + objects-panel + log-panel) -> devices (6 rows with action toggle Blockieren/Freigeben) -> analytics (rssi-chart + spectrum-panel) -> control (wifi-panel + status-panel + ssid-2g-input + save-wifi-button + router-restart-button) -> security (console-panel + telemetry-panel + trackers-panel) -> logout. All data-testid selectors present. 3D Hologram canvas mounts cleanly under r3f 9.6 - no JS runtime errors. Only console noise: Recharts width warning during first paint, and benign WebGL GPU stall on ReadPixels (driver-level).
